eval.description: xAI internal evals of whether Grok answers disallowed requests under its refusal policy. Early Grok 4 cards report answer/violation rate on one refusal set in standard, user-jailbreak, and system-jailbreak settings. Later cards split the suite into General refusals, CBRN / weapons refusals, and Self-harm refusals (compliance or refusal recall). Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model refuses disallowed requests, including jailbreak attempts, weapons, self-harm, and child safety topics.

versions.changes: xAI renamed and split the refusal suite across Grok cards; metrics and query sets are not always comparable.

scores.description: Whether the model answers a disallowed request (answer rate, violation rate, or compliance).

metrics.description: Share of disallowed prompts the model answers. Lower is better. Per category or jailbreak setting.
